scripts.build: pnpm --filter @polina-vet/studio typegen && pnpm --filter @polina-vet/web build && pnpm --filter @polina-vet/studio build
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm --filter @polina-vet/operations check && pnpm --filter @polina-vet/intake check && pnpm --filter @polina-vet/office check && pnpm --filter @polina-vet/web check && pnpm --filter @polina-vet/studio check && pnpm --filter @polina-vet/operations test && pnpm --filter @polina-vet/web test:unit && pnpm validate:content && pnpm build
scripts.validate:content: node scripts/validate-content.mjs && node --test scripts/validate-content.test.mjs && node scripts/validate-m10.mjs
scripts.release:validate: node scripts/validate-release.mjs && pnpm build && node scripts/validate-seo.mjs
